title: ActField: Learning Action Effects as Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.30659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning how actions change visual states is essential for prediction and decision-making in embodied tasks. Existing action-conditioned JEPA world models typically predict future representations at discrete observation intervals, leaving the temporal evolution of action effects implicit. We introduce ActField, a continuous-time JEPA world model that explicitly models latent state evolution through an action-conditioned vector field integrated over physical time. ActField separates action-independent evolution from action-induced changes, with the latter modulated by the latent context. A reference-conditioned representation and multi-step dynamics loss further support accurate long-horizon prediction. Together, these components provide a structured and temporally continuous formulation for predicting action-conditioned visual dynamics. translated_title: ActField：将动作效应学习为连续时间潜在动力学
translated_abstract: 学习动作如何改变视觉状态对于具身任务中的预测和决策至关重要。现有的动作条件JEPA世界模型通常在离散的观测间隔上预测未来表示，使得动作效应的时间演化是隐式的。我们提出ActField，一个连续时间的JEPA世界模型，它通过在物理时间上积分的动作条件向量场，显式地对潜在状态演化进行建模。ActField将独立于动作的演化与动作引起的变化分离开来，其中后者由潜在上下文进行调制。参考条件表示和多步动力学损失进一步支持了精确的长时程预测。这些组件共同为预测动作条件下的视觉动力学提供了一个结构化且时间连续的公式化方法。在LIBERO、DROID和BEHAVIOR数据集上的实验表明，该方法提升了视觉预测的保真度，并且……
tldr: ActField提出了一种连续时间JEPA世界模型，通过在物理时间上积分的动作条件向量场显式建模潜在状态的演化，将动作无关演化与动作引起的变化分离，从而实现更精确的长时程动作条件视觉动力学预测。
en_tdlr: ActField is a continuous-time JEPA world model that explicitly models latent state evolution through an action-conditioned vector field integrated over physical time, separating action-independent evolution from action-induced changes to achieve more accurate long-horizon action-conditioned visual dynamics prediction.
